Card Q&A.a: No, it can't. Even if a target Digimon of this card's [When Digivolving] effect becomes a level 9 or higher Digimon, it can't attack players.
Card Q&A.q: I chose 1 opponent's Digimon with a play cost of 8 or less as the target for "can't attack players" in this card's [When Digivolving] effect. If that opponent's Digimon digivolves during their next turn and becomes a Digimon with a play cost of 9 or more, can it now attack players?

Effect: [When Digivolving] ＜De-Digivolve 1＞ 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, 1 of their Digimon with a play cost of 8 or less can't attack players until the end of their turn.
Inherited Effect: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When another of your Digimon with [Diaboromon] in its name is played, ＜De-Digivolve 1＞ 1 of your opponent's Digimon.
